corrections_entry.plan_assumption: the plan adds a producer identity only to candidates (migration 3); evidence and verdicts need no producer field.
corrections_entry.actually: verdicts is the higher-stakes table -- it decides whether a research claim is novel -- and report.json/verdicts.jsonl are per-run artefacts, not the system of record. With no producer column, a model-produced verdict is stored indistinguishably from a replay-produced one: the same FAIL-A hazard as candidates, one table over.
corrections_entry.evidence: Verifier V4A verbatim: 'Store gap => RISK, not acceptable interim. No producer on evidence/verdicts, but candidates does have one from migration 3 for this exact FAIL-A hazard.' Fixed here by schema v4: evidence.producer + verdicts.producer, vocabulary reused verbatim (model|replay|fixture|unknown, NOT 'none'), plus nullable verdicts.model; fail-closed backfill leaves every old row 'unknown'.
